emails.subject: Requisition for High-Performance Computing (HPC) Cluster
emails.body: Dear HoD, We urgently require an HPC cluster for deep learning research. The estimated budget required is INR 45,00,000 (Rs. 45 lakh). Quotations from empaneled vendors are being gathered.

emails.subject: Re: Requisition for High-Performance Computing (HPC) Cluster - Quotation Comparative
emails.body: The technical purchase committee evaluated two quotes: Vendor NetScale (Rs. 46.2 lakh) and HPC-Tech Systems (Rs. 42.5 lakh / INR 42,50,000). HPC-Tech Systems meets all GPU compute requirements with 3-year onsite warranty.

emails.subject: Re: Requisition for High-Performance Computing (HPC) Cluster - Conditional Approval
emails.body: The proposal for procurement of HPC cluster from HPC-Tech Systems for Rs. 42.5 lakh is approved in-principle, subject to receiving clearance from the Institute Finance Committee regarding funding source allocation.

emails.subject: Re: HPC Cluster - Finance Clearance Query
emails.body: Please clarify whether the annual maintenance contract (AMC) from the 4th year onwards will be borne by the sponsored research project overhead or the departmental operational budget.

emails.subject: Re: HPC Cluster - Finance Clearance Clarification
emails.body: It is confirmed that AMC post 3rd year will be funded through the project contingency grant. Awaiting final clearance so purchase order can be released.

synthetic_threads.subject: Emergency Repair and Manifold Replacement in Chemistry Lab Gas Pipeline

emails.subject: Emergency Repair and Manifold Replacement in Chemistry Lab Gas Pipeline
emails.body: A minor gas leakage was detected in the secondary gas manifold in Research Lab 3. The urgent repair quote received from M/s FlameSafe Engineers is INR 1,85,000 (Rs. 1.85 lakh).

emails.subject: Re: Emergency Repair in Chemistry Lab Gas Pipeline - Work Order Approved
emails.body: Given safety concerns, work order is hereby approved for M/s FlameSafe Engineers for INR 1,85,000 to execute the manifold replacement immediately.

emails.subject: URGENT: Safety Compliance Failure regarding M/s FlameSafe
emails.body: During site inspection this morning, M/s FlameSafe failed to produce a valid PESO certified pressure vessel license. The technician's gas line certification expired six months ago.

emails.subject: REVOCATION: Work Order for M/s FlameSafe Cancelled with Immediate Effect
emails.body: In view of safety non-compliance, the work order granted to M/s FlameSafe Engineers on 11 September is revoked and cancelled immediately. No payment or site access is to be permitted.

emails.subject: Re: REVOCATION: Work Order for M/s FlameSafe Cancelled - Fresh Tender Call
emails.body: Understood. The premises have been sealed and a fresh emergency tender notice will be published for certified pipeline contractors on Monday.

synthetic_threads.subject: Annual Laboratory Glassware & Consumables Budget Allocation 2026-27

emails.subject: Annual Laboratory Glassware & Consumables Budget Allocation 2026-27
emails.body: Submitting the consolidated glassware and chemical reagent requirement for undergraduate labs. Estimated requirement for the fiscal year is Rs. 2,50,000 (INR 2.50 lakh).

emails.subject: Re: Annual Laboratory Glassware Budget - Accepted for Planning
emails.body: The estimate of Rs. 2,50,000 is noted and accepted for annual budget planning purposes only. This communication does not constitute financial sanction or approval to purchase items.

emails.subject: Indent for Borosil Beakers and Pipettes
emails.body: Based on the Dean's acceptance of our Rs. 2.5 lakh budget, can we place the direct order for Borosil beakers worth Rs. 45,000?

emails.subject: Re: Indent for Borosil Beakers and Pipettes - Policy Reminder
emails.body: No. Annual budget planning acceptance does not permit direct buying. You must submit a separate purchase requisition with 3 competitive quotes through the departmental procurement portal for sanction.

synthetic_threads.subject: Proposal for Campus Inter-Hostel High-Speed Fiber Backbone Upgrade

emails.subject: Proposal for Campus Inter-Hostel High-Speed Fiber Backbone Upgrade
emails.body: The Computer Center proposes laying 12-core single-mode optical fiber connecting North Hostel Complex to Central Datacenter. Total estimated project cost is INR 12,75,000 (12.75 lakh / Rs. 12,75,000).

emails.subject: Re: Proposal for Campus Fiber Backbone Upgrade
emails.body: The proposal is strategically sound. Before administrative financial sanction, please coordinate with Estate Office to ensure trenching does not damage water supply mains.

emails.subject: Re: Fiber Trenching Clearance along Perimeter Road
emails.body: Estate civil engineers have surveyed the proposed 1.2 km path along Ring Road. Clearance is granted provided trenching is completed using trenchless directional drilling near the main gate.

emails.subject: Re: Campus Fiber Backbone Upgrade - Estate NOC Received
emails.body: Estate NOC has been received with directional drilling condition. Resubmitting file for Director's final administrative and financial approval for Rs. 12,75,000.
